solar_pv.name: Longi Solar Hi-MO 5 (LR5-72HPH-550M)
solar_pv.description: Tier 1 high-efficiency monocrystalline PERC module with Gallium-doped technology, optimal for high ambient temperatures in Surabaya.

source.title: Tokopedia Longi Solar Official & Asosiasi Energi Surya Indonesia (AESI) Price Index Q3 2024
source.notes: Verified distributor pricing in Surabaya, East Java. Turnkey price includes tier-1 grid-tie inverter, aluminium mounting, cables, panel boards, and SLO certification.

solar_pv.name: Trina Solar Vertex (TSM-DE19-550W)
solar_pv.description: Multi-busbar technology with non-destructive cutting to deliver superior mechanical load resistance and lower hotspot risks under partial shading.

source.title: Trina Solar Vertex Series Datasheet & PT Surya Utama Nuansa Commercial Catalog
source.notes: Surabaya project benchmark for commercial & industrial (C&I) rooftop solar installations.

solar_pv.name: Canadian Solar HiKu6 (CS6W-545MS)
solar_pv.description: Dual-cell technology minimizing micro-cracking and delivering lower levelized cost of energy (LCOE).

source.title: Tokopedia Distributor Canadian Solar Indonesia Official
source.notes: Surveyed Q3 2024 from Authorized Solar Distributors in East Java.

source.title: Penguin Indonesia Official Store Surabaya

toren_tanks.name: Penguin TB 200 (2,000 L)
toren_tanks.description: Standard university building modular tank with high UV stability.

source.title: Penguin Indonesia Official Catalog Surabaya
source.notes: Standard unit for faculty buildings and department workshops.

toren_tanks.name: Profil Tank BWS 3,100 L (Stainless Steel)

source.title: Profil Tank Indonesia Official Product Directory

toren_tanks.name: Profil Tank BDA 5,000 L
toren_tanks.description: Commercial multi-cubic rainwater detention tank for large academic building roofs.

source.title: Tokopedia Distributor Profil Tank Jawa Timur

toren_tanks.name: Profil Tank BDA 10,000 L

dry_wells.name: Modular Dry Well (Sumur Resapan Standar SNI 8456:2017)
dry_wells.components: Precast reinforced concrete rings (buis beton dia 100cm, depth 2.5m), split stone gravel (20cm), ijuk fiber filter, precast cover slab with PVC inlet
dry_wells.description: Engineered stormwater infiltration well accelerating surface runoff absorption into Surabaya unconfined aquifer and mitigating perimeter overland pooling.

source.title: SNI 8456:2017 (Sumur dan Parit Resapan Air Hujan) & Standar Satuan Harga / HSPK Kota Surabaya 2024
source.notes: Cost breakdown: 5 buis beton rings @ Rp 180k, cover slab Rp 250k, gravel & ijuk Rp 300k, manual excavation & labor Rp 850k.

retention_ponds.name: Engineered Retention Pond (Kolam Retensi / Detensi Permen PUPR 11/2014)
retention_ponds.components: Mechanical excavation, non-woven geotextile liner (250 g/m²), rip-rap stone masonry embankment (1:4), spillway weir with silt trap
retention_ponds.description: Surface detention basin intercepting overland drainage flow across a 120m radius, providing significant peak flood attenuation for surrounding buildings.

source.title: Peraturan Menteri PUPR No. 11/PRT/M/2014 tentang Pengelolaan Air Hujan & HSPK Pekerjaan Pengairan Surabaya 2024
source.notes: Unit price includes earthwork excavation (Rp 75k/m³), geotextile lining (Rp 35k/m²), stone masonry berms, and hydraulic outlet.

plants.name: Tabebuya Kuning / Sakura Surabaya (Handroanthus chrysotrichus)
plants.description: The signature street tree of Surabaya city. Seasonal yellow blossom, deep root system that does not crack sidewalk pavements or asphalt, excellent roadside urban shade.

source.title: Dahlan, E.N. (2010). 'Kajian Kemampuan Pohon Hutan Kota Menyerap Karbondioksida' & DKRTH Surabaya Street Tree Planting Program
source.notes: Transplant sapling height 2.5 - 3.0 m. Market price from Pasar Bunga Kayoon & Bratang, Surabaya.

plants.name: Trembesi / Rain Tree (Samanea saman)
plants.description: Giant umbrella canopy providing superior tropical shading and highest CO2 sequestration of any urban tropical tree. Ideal for wide boulevards and campus greens.

source.title: Prof. Endes N. Dahlan (IPB University). 'Kemampuan Pohon Hutan Kota dalam Reduksi Gas Rumah Kaca dan Pencemaran Udara'
source.notes: Highest carbon absorption champion (28.5 tons CO2/tree/year mature stage, 28.5 kg/yr juvenile stage).

plants.name: Angsana / Sono Kembang (Pterocarpus indicus)
plants.description: Rapid-growing tropical urban shade tree with nitrogen-fixing root nodules. Excellent for campus avenues and pedestrian boulevards.

source.title: Dahlan (2010) & Survey Pedagang Bibit Tanaman Surabaya

plants.name: Ketapang Kencana (Terminalia mantaly)
plants.description: Layered horizontal tiered foliage creating an elegant modern architectural shade. Excellent for campus plazas, parking lots, and walkways.

source.title: Pasar Bunga Bratang Surabaya Price Survey

plants.name: Pucuk Merah / Red Lip (Syzygium myrtifolium)
plants.description: Dense tropical shrub with red juvenile leaves. High capacity for absorbing airborne particulate matter and dampening ground thermal radiation.

source.title: Purnomowati et al. (2019). 'Particulate matter accumulation and microclimate alteration by Syzygium myrtifolium in tropical urban environments'
source.notes: Hedge density ~1.5 plants per linear meter.

plants.name: Bougainvillea / Bunga Kertas (Bougainvillea spectabilis)
plants.description: Extreme drought- and heat-tolerant flowering shrub, widely used on Surabaya median strips and road barriers for glare reduction and thermal buffer.

source.title: Pedoman Penataan Jalur Hijau Median Jalan Kota Surabaya (DKRTH 2023)
source.notes: High survival rate in Surabaya tropical climate.

plants.name: Rumput Gajah Mini / Dwarf Carpet Grass (Axonopus compressus cv. Dwarf)
plants.description: Dense, low-growing carpet grass preventing soil erosion along road shoulders and reducing land surface temperature by 3.5°C compared to bare asphalt/concrete.

source.title: Taman Flora Surabaya Vendor Listing
source.notes: Price per square meter installed with humus topsoil.

plants.name: Lee Kuan Yew Facade Trellis Frame (Vernonia elliptica)
plants.description: Singapore-style modular planter box and stainless steel wire trellis with drip irrigation. Drops building wall surface temperature by 2.4 - 3.8°C.

source.title: Perini, K. et al. (2017). 'Vertical greening systems and thermal performance in tropical and Mediterranean climates'. Energy and Buildings, 143, 35-42
source.notes: Cost per square meter facade area including stainless steel tension cables, planter troughs, and drip piping.
